[FACT] User has been experimenting with bitters and made their own orange bitters using orange peels and vodka.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new cocktail recipes to try out.  
[PREFERENCE] User specifically requested Whiskey Sour recipes that use orange bitters.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on making homemade orange bitters and praised their mixology skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a Classic Whiskey Sour recipe with orange bitters, including the following details:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 oz Whiskey (bourbon or rye)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 3/4 oz freshly squeezed lemon juice  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 oz simple syrup  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 dashes orange bitters  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Egg white (optional, for a silky texture)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions to shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a rocks glass over ice, and garnish with a lemon wheel or twist.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an alternative recipe titled "Orange You Glad It's a Whiskey Sour?" with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 oz Whiskey (bourbon or rye)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 3/4 oz freshly squeezed orange juice  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 oz honey syrup (1:1 honey and water, dissolved)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 dashes orange bitters  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Splash of club soda  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions to shake whiskey, orange juice, and honey syrup with ice, strain into a highball glass filled with ice, top with club soda, and garnish with an orange slice or wheel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a third recipe titled "Smoky Orange Whiskey Sour" with the following details:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 oz Smoked Whiskey (or add a dash of Lapsang souchong tea-infused simple syrup to regular whiskey)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 3/4 oz freshly squeezed lemon juice  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 oz simple syrup  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 dashes orange bitters  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 dash of black pepper tincture (optional, for added depth)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided instructions to shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a rocks glass over ice, and garnish with a lemon twist and a sprig of rosemary or thyme.
